tasks.interfaces: Consumes: the design's Configuration table; Produces: `config.CONTACTS_CACHE`, `config.CONTACTS_CACHE_MAX_ACCOUNTS` and `config.CONTACTS_CACHE_IDLE_SECONDS`
tasks.title: Add the contacts cache configuration variables
tasks.verification: `.venv/bin/pytest -q` passes with tests for the defaults, overrides and rejection of `0` and negative values; `.venv/bin/ruff check src tests` is clean; the comments are reviewed

tasks.interfaces: Consumes: `_vcard_to_dict`, `_is_group`; Produces: `fold`, `CachedCard`, `build_card(url, etag, vcard_text) -> CachedCard | None`
tasks.title: Add text folding and the cached-card builder
tasks.verification: `.venv/bin/pytest -q` passes with tests for: - `fold("José García") == "jose garcia"`, and `fold("Straße")` folding `ß`; - every field searched today appearing in `name_text` or `other_text`; - groups flagged as groups; - unparsable cards returning `None`. Also: `ruff` is clean, and the docstrings are reviewed.

tasks.interfaces: Consumes: `build_card` and `CachedCard` from task 1.2, the config defaults from task 1.1, and the existing `_default_addressbook_url` and `_fetch_all_vcards`; Produces: the `ContactCache` class with the design's method signatures, raising `requests.HTTPError` unchanged on failures
tasks.risk: high; incorrect delta handling would serve stale data. The cache can be disabled with `CONTACTS_CACHE=false`.
tasks.title: Build the per-credential cache with incremental sync
tasks.verification: `.venv/bin/pytest -q` passes with fake-server tests for: - a cold load; - a warm call with no change, issuing exactly one REPORT; - a changed card fetched by multiget; - a deleted card removed; - a 412 rebuild; - 401 and 500 raising with no cards and the entry unchanged; - a different password never reading another entry; - the cap and idle expiry with an injected clock; - `record_write` and `record_delete` visible on the next call; - only GET, PROPFIND and REPORT being issued. Also: `ruff` is clean, and the docstrings are reviewed.

tasks.interfaces: Consumes: `ContactCache.cards()` and `CachedCard` from tasks 1.2 and 1.3, and the config from task 1.1; Produces: `list_contacts(page_size: int = 50, cursor: str | None = None, fields: list[str] | None = None) -> dict`, plus the shared helpers `_page(results, page_size, cursor, fingerprint, fields)` and `_project(card, fields)` that search reuses
tasks.risk: medium; this breaks the `contacts_list` output shape (accepted in discovery)
tasks.title: Implement paged listing with cursors and field projection
tasks.verification: `.venv/bin/pytest -q` passes with tests for: - a 120-person traversal returning everyone exactly once in folded name order, with a correct `total` and no cursor on the last page; - adds and removes between pages producing no duplicates; - a malformed cursor, and a search cursor reused for the list, raising the restart error; - default summaries, named fields, `["all"]` equal to `_vcard_to_dict`, and an unknown field raising; - the kill switch making a full fetch on every call. Also: `ruff` is clean, and the docstrings are reviewed.

tasks.interfaces: Consumes: `ContactCache.record_write` / `record_delete` from task 1.3; Produces: create, update and delete keeping their current signatures and return values while updating the cache
tasks.title: Keep the cache current after the server's own writes
tasks.verification: `.venv/bin/pytest -q` passes with tests showing that a create, an update and a delete through the fake server appear in the next `list_contacts` even when the fake change report omits them, and that a failed PUT leaves the cache unchanged; `ruff` is clean

tasks.interfaces: Consumes: `_page`, `_project`, `fold` and `ContactCache.cards()`; Produces: `search_contacts(query: str, page_size: int = 50, cursor: str | None = None, fields: list[str] | None = None) -> dict`
tasks.risk: medium; this breaks the `contacts_search` output shape (accepted in discovery)
tasks.title: Rewrite search with folding, word matching and ranking
tasks.verification: `.venv/bin/pytest -q` passes with tests for: - "jose garcia" finding "José García"; - "garcia jose" finding the same contact; - "jose" ranking a name match above an organization-only match; - phone digits in several formats; - `@username`; - an empty query raising; - a search cursor working and being rejected for a different query; - the existing search tests, updated to the new output shape. Also: `ruff` is clean, and the docstrings are reviewed.

tasks.interfaces: Consumes: `list_contacts` / `search_contacts` from tasks 2.1 and 2.3; Produces: the MCP tool schemas and the `{contacts, total, next_cursor}` structured output
tasks.title: Expose paging parameters on the MCP list and search tools
tasks.verification: `.venv/bin/pytest -q` passes, including the new protocol tests; `ruff` is clean; the descriptions are reviewed

tasks.interfaces: Consumes: CardDAV read access through the project's local credentials file, plus `list_contacts` and `search_contacts`; Produces: `live-results.md` with the cold and warm timings (median and maximum), the largest page in bytes, the traversal comparison and the accent-search results as counts
tasks.title: Measure speed, page size and completeness live
tasks.verification: - warm median and maximum both under 0.5 s; - largest default page at most 16,000 bytes; - the traversal equals the direct download, with every person exactly once; - every accent-folded probe finds its target.

tasks.interfaces: Consumes: the MCP server from task 2.4, iPhone Mirroring and the user's go-ahead; Produces: `freshness-check.md` recording the before and after values, the cache path taken (warm delta) and the deletion result
tasks.risk: medium; it edits a throwaway card in the user's account. No real contact is touched, and the user does the deletion.
tasks.title: Prove an edit made on the iPhone shows up in the next call
tasks.verification: - the edited value is returned by the first call after the edit; - the deleted cards are absent from the first call after the deletion; - the ETag comparisons show no other card changed.

tasks.interfaces: Consumes: `live-results.md` and `freshness-check.md`; Produces: updated docs and a pull request URL
tasks.title: Document, push the branch and open the stacked PR
tasks.verification: `.venv/bin/pytest -q` and `ruff` pass on the pushed head; the pull request exists with the correct base and description
